newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: China's Fujian refinery to restart on Saturday.
newsitem.headline: China's Fujian refinery to restart on Saturday.

text.p: China's southeastern Fujian refinery will restart its 80,000-barrel-per-day crude unit on Saturday after more than one month of maintenance shutdown, a refinery source said on Friday.
"All the works have been done and we will restart on Saturday as scheduled," the source said by telephone from Fujian.
After the restart, its annual capacity would be raised to four million tonnes (80,000 barrel-per-day) from 2.5 million tonnes (51,000 bpd), the source said.
The refinery delayed its original maintenance turnaround to late April from early April, postponing the restart by two weeks to end of May.
The refinery has said it would boost its annual capacity to 12 million tonnes by the year 2000.
